alternatives_rejected.why: CPU saturation would raise its own processing time, but own-span self-time p50 is unchanged at 0.14ms (E2); only the inbound, network-observed latency grew 5.13->204.83ms (E2).

Its p90 latency rise (z=82, E1) is far smaller than currencyservice's p50 deviation (z=408, E1). Checkout calls currency, so its slowdown fits downstream propagation from the delayed currencyservice calls (E2).

Frontend latency deviations (z=103/69, E1) are smaller than currencyservice's (z=408, E1), and frontend sits upstream of the currency calls whose caller-observed latency rose 40x (E2); it is a victim.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect currencyservice's network path (pod netem/tc rules, sidecar/proxy, node network) and remove the injected latency, e.g. delete the tc qdisc delay rule or the chaos experiment. Then confirm inbound p50 to currencyservice returns to about 5ms.
